name: Eleven v3 Conversational
access: ElevenLabs API: Text to Dialogue WebSocket
ElevenAgents (agent TTS model; expressive mode is on by default with it)

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text streamed in, with optional inline audio tags
voice.output_audio: MP3 (22.05 kHz at 32 kbps, 24 kHz at 48 kbps, 44.1 kHz at 32 to 192 kbps), PCM 8 to 48 kHz 16-bit, WAV 8 to 48 kHz, Opus 48 kHz (32 to 192 kbps), mu-law 8 kHz and A-law 8 kHz; the default is mp3_44100_128; MP3 at 192 kbps needs the Creator plan or above, and PCM or WAV at 44.1 kHz needs Pro or above [el-api-tts]; ElevenAgents defaults to PCM 16 kHz output and accepts PCM 8 to 48 kHz and mu-law 8 kHz [el-api-agents]
voice.voices: custom cloning: library voices (the maker's pages give 3,000+, 10,000+ and 5,000+ as counts), instant and professional voice clones, and designed voices [el-tts-overview] [el-voices]; the Text to Dialogue WebSocket allows one registered voice for this model, and it does not preserve professional voice clones well [el-api-ttd-ws] [el-agents-expressive]
languages: 70+ languages, up from about 32 on the Flash models [el-agents-expressive]
voice.turn_detection: none in the model. In ElevenAgents the turn-taking system uses signals from Scribe v2 Realtime, including prosody, to time the agent's reply [el-agents-expressive]
voice.interruption: Not handled by the model. In ElevenAgents, users can interrupt unless interruptions are disabled; the docs describe no cancel message for the Text to Dialogue WebSocket [el-agents-flow] [el-ws-ttd]
voice.latency: About 280 ms, excluding application and network latency [el-models]; Artificial Analysis reports a median of 65.5 characters generated per second (throughput, not latency) [aa-tts-board]
voice.session_limit: Text to Dialogue WebSocket: closes after 20 seconds without a client message unless keep_alive is sent; each open connection holds one dialogue session [el-ws-ttd]. The models page lists no character limit for this model. An ElevenAgents conversation lasts 600 seconds by default, adjustable from 60 to 7,200 [el-agents-flow]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. API list price US$0.04 per 1,000 characters [el-pricing-api]. In ElevenAgents the page says it costs the same as other agent speech models, from US$0.08 per call minute, with LLM cost separate [el-agents-expressive] [el-pricing-agents]. Artificial Analysis lists US$50 per 1M characters, which does not match the list price [aa-tts-board]

benchmarks.setting: median generation speed; read from the leaderboard data on the Artificial Analysis text-to-speech page
